note: V2.18a (Section 2/8) - additive, read-only-with-respect-to-source overlay that formalizes lifecycle status for existing eval/golden/*.json and eval/conversations/*.json cases WITHOUT modifying those files. Entries here are looked up by case_id; a case with no entry defaults to lifecycle_status=OPEN (app.intelligence_diagnostics.scenario_registry). This is purely additive metadata - never a substitute for, or edit to, the underlying golden case content, and it can never remove a case from the registry (Section 8/9 append-only philosophy).
